description: This file defines a CSV data generator class for object detection datasets, including functions for parsing class and annotation CSV files, and methods for loading images and annotations. It is part of a larger object detection framework, specifically for handling CSV formatted datasets.

classes.name: CSVGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates data for a custom CSV dataset, providing methods to access dataset size, classes, labels, images, and annotations.

methods.name: _parse
methods.description: Parses a string into a specified type, raising a formatted ValueError on failure.

methods.name: _read_classes
methods.description: Reads class definitions from a CSV reader, returning an ordered dictionary of class names to class IDs.

methods.name: _read_annotations
methods.description: Reads annotations from a CSV reader, associating image files with bounding box annotations and class labels.

methods.name: _open_for_csv
methods.description: Opens a CSV file with appropriate mode depending on Python version for reading.
